title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Limited Edition Strawberry Melon Cooler 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Melon Cooler is a vibrant fusion from Riot Squad’s Bar Edition Limited Edition collection, pairing sun-ripened Strawberry with smooth, refreshing Melon. These bright, summery fruit flavours are topped off with a clean Menthol note, giving the blend a crisp and satisfying lift. Mint infused This nicotine salt e-liquid delivers fast-acting satisfaction with a tactile yet smooth throat hit, perfectly suited for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod systems, pens, and starter kits. Choose between 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths to suit your needs. Riot Squad’s Bar Edition Nic Salt range is crafted in the UK to replicate the layered, icy sweetness of disposable-style flavours, but with the practicality and value of refillable 10ml bottles. Strawberry Melon Cooler is an excellent choice for fans of chilled, fruity vapes with mellow balance and a cool edge.
